source_inspection.finding: ColorParser first constrains the complete suffix; CommandFactoryNote then resolves that same token with HColorSet. Whole transparent/background become HColors.none, whole automatic becomes HColorAutomagic, and gradient endpoints use parseSimpleColor so sentinel endpoints are invalid.

HColor.toSvg preserves intermediate alpha, XColor.toSvg canonicalizes alpha zero to #00000000 and alpha FF to RGB, DriverPathSvg uses WITH_FILL_NONE, fixColor maps #00000000 to none, and fillMe emits five-decimal A/255 opacity for remaining eight-digit fills.

ColorTrieNode case-insensitively resolves the seven ArchiMate aliases to FFFFCC, C2F0FF, CCCCFF, F8E7C0, C9FFC9, 97FF97 and FFE0E0. Legacy gradient creation calls HColor.toRGB on both endpoints and therefore discards alpha before resource creation.

The shared named-note parser validates grammar and resolution before either family creates an entity. The implementation revision adds the seven source-cited aliases, resolve_color_rgb for gradient projection/dedup, and hcolor_fill_attributes for transparent and flat RGBA body/fold paint in both families.
